report.requirement: The controller's identity and how to contact it about personal data
report.reason: The policy clearly states the identity of the controller.

report.requirement: Contact details of the data protection officer (DPO)
report.condition: The controller has appointed a DPO
report.evidence: You can contact our Data Protection Officer by sending an email to privacy@zoom.us.
report.reason: The policy provides contact details for the Data Protection Officer.

report.requirement: The personal data that is collected
report.evidence: we may collect, or process on behalf of our customers, the following categories of personal data
report.reason: The policy specifies the categories of personal data collected.

report.requirement: The means used to collect personal data
report.evidence: we receive information from sources as described in the 'What Personal Data Do We Receive?' section
report.reason: The policy mentions means of collection but does not detail all methods.

report.requirement: The purpose of collecting and processing personal data
report.evidence: Zoom uses personal data for the following business and commercial purposes: to provide Zoom Products and Services
report.reason: The policy clearly states the purposes for collecting and processing personal data.

report.requirement: The legal basis for collecting personal data (e.g. consent, contract, legal obligation)
report.evidence: we rely on the following legal bases as applicable in your jurisdiction
report.reason: The policy clearly states the legal bases for processing personal data.

report.requirement: Which personal data is mandatory and which is optional
report.evidence: we may collect, or process on behalf of our customers, the following categories of personal data
report.reason: The policy specifies categories of personal data collected, indicating which may be mandatory or optional.

report.requirement: The consequences of not providing personal data
report.evidence: some usage data collection is optional and may be controlled by your Diagnostic Data Preferences Setting
report.reason: The policy mentions optional data but does not clearly outline consequences of not providing data.

report.requirement: The parties personal data is disclosed or shared with, and their capacity
report.evidence: Zoom provides personal data to third parties only with consent or in one of the following circumstances
report.reason: The policy clearly states the parties with whom personal data is shared.

report.requirement: Whether personal data is transferred, disclosed or processed outside the Kingdom
report.evidence: your personal data may be transferred to or stored in the United States where we are established, as well as in other countries outside of the EEA
report.reason: The policy explicitly mentions the transfer of personal data outside the Kingdom.

report.requirement: How long personal data is kept, or the criteria used to decide
report.evidence: We retain personal data for as long as required to engage in the uses described in this Privacy Statement
report.reason: The policy clearly states how long personal data is kept.

report.requirement: How personal data is stored and destroyed
report.reason: The policy does not mention how personal data is stored and destroyed.

report.requirement: The data subject's rights: to be informed, access, obtain a copy, correct, and request destruction
report.evidence: your rights in relation to your personal data processed by us as a controller specifically include: Right of access and/or portability
report.reason: The policy clearly outlines the data subject's rights.

report.requirement: How the data subject can exercise their rights
report.evidence: To exercise your rights, please click here.
report.reason: The policy provides information on how to exercise rights.

report.evidence: You have the right to withdraw your consent at any time by visiting our cookie management tool
report.reason: The policy mentions withdrawal of consent but only in the context of cookies.

report.requirement: The measures taken to protect personal data
report.condition: Large-scale or continuous processing, monitoring, new technologies, or automated decisions
report.evidence: Zoom uses advanced tools to automatically scan certain types of content such as virtual backgrounds, profile images, incoming emails to Zoom’s native email service
report.reason: The policy mentions measures for content scanning but lacks detail on overall data protection measures.

report.requirement: Whether decisions are made solely by automated processing
report.condition: Large-scale or continuous processing, monitoring, new technologies, or automated decisions
report.reason: The policy does not address whether decisions are made solely by automated processing.
